name: Static Link
description: Forms a connection with the target. Whilst the link is still active, at the start of every turn, steals %dmg_steal% damage from the target and gives a free attack at the end of each turn. If Discharge is not adjacent to the linked target at the end of his turn, the link will break. The damage buff/debuff lingers for %buff_linger_duration% turns after the link is broken.
